Name: Ruska's Pygmy Goats
Author: Ruskanoa
Description:
This mod uses CP to replace the original SDV .png files for the adult and baby goats. I haven’t tested if it works with other mods that change animals, but [i]it should work[/i] as long as said mods don’t do anything with the original goat .png files.

[list]
[*]Adult pygmy goats are shorter than regular goats, have different eyes, bigger horns, more hair, etc.
[*]Baby pygmy goats are smaller and have more ‘baby-like’ features.
[*]Don’t panic if you see the regular goat icon at Marnie’s shop. I haven’t changed it yet.
[*]Inspiration for the adult goat sprites came from [url=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/aa/Too_much_ramming.jpg]this good-looking individual[/url].
[/list]
[b]NOTE[/b]: this is my very first published mod and, of course, I made a dumb mistake with the manifest.json. The "Update Keys" number should be [b]10836[/b], NOT 10834, you can manually change it if you want SMAPI to work properly for any future updates.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Ruska's Pygmy Goats
Manifest.Description: Replaces the vanilla SDV goats with custom ones.
Manifest.Author: Ruska
